payload.title: Tailnet Presence copy actions fail after command-environment hardening

expectation.text: A Tailnet Presence bar widget that displays online and offline machines should copy the selected machine label or address to the Wayland clipboard when its copy action is used.

payload.observed: The optional Tailnet Presence widget displayed online and offline machines, but its copy actions stopped working after command-execution hardening removed the desktop-session environment required by the clipboard helper. This is a repair to a custom plugin, not a stock Omarchy defect.
